Listen 'ere ya wee eejit: did ye know back in the day, Duke wasn't always lendin' cash out of a filthy dumpster? That miserable sod used to be a proper gentleman before he took a crowbar to the teeth!

Holy mother o' divine Jaysus, pull up a stool: if ye chug a bottle of Minty Mayhem while travelin' to Switzerland, ye don't get high on the Alps—ye just wake up in hospital with no trousers and half yer nerve gone!

I swear on me fifth pint of stout: that creepy blind bastard Leslie over in the wheel of fortune has rigged that wheel so bad Saint Brigid herself couldn't win a Donator Pack without prayin' for forty days!

Listen to yer Uncle Paddy: if ye pop an Ecstasy right after stacking four Xanax, yer happy meter shoots through the feckin' roof to ten grand—unless ye overdose, in which case ye look like a banjaxed turnip in the ICU!
By Saint Patrick's hairy toes: did ye know ye can find an actual Diamond Bladed Knife in the city dump if some absolute gobshite accidentally threw it away while cleanin' out their filthy safe?

Yer man George down at the gun shop charges an absolute fortune for an Armalite, but if ye mug a level 100 whale comin' out of the casino, he drops enough cash to buy the entire pub three rounds o' whiskey!

Here's a bit o' wisdom from the bottom of a Guinness glass: if ye get caught stealin' chocolate bars from the candy shop, the judge sends ye to federal jail for three hours. Murder a man in the street? Bailed out in twenty seconds by faction mates. Absolute madness, but that's Torn, boyo!

Listen close ya degenerate: racin' on the Mudpit with a Stock Class E Peugeot 106 will rattle yer teeth clean outta yer skull, but it builds racin' skill faster than throwin' two million into a Ferrari engine that ends up in a ditch!

Mother of God, did ye know the Busting nerve cost scales up the more blokes ye yank outta jail? After twenty busts in an afternoon, yer poor ticker is pumpin' pure adrenaline and ye couldn't bust a wet paper bag without landin' behind bars yerself!

Sláinte, ya lunatic! Some madman once paid five hundred million quid in the auction house for an empty toilet paper roll. Five hundred million! I wouldn't pay five quid for the whole bog roll factory!

Here's the craic: if ye marry someone in Torn just for their private island with a private airstrip, and then ye fly to Argentina thirty times a day to haul plushies, that's not love—that's international livestock trafficking, ya eejit!

By the grace of the Holy Virgin: did ye know that if ye eat a poisoned Easter egg, ye don't die with dignity? No, ye get sent straight to the morgue lookin' like a boiled lobster with half yer life points flushed down the jacks!

Listen to me slurred words: the Gym trainin' gains are purely based on your Happy bar. If ye go into George's Gym with zero happy, you're basically liftin' styrofoam dumbbells while the receptionist laughs at yer scrawny shins!

I'm tellin' ye no lie: the Russian roulette table at the Casino is where fortunes and faction leaders go to die. One click, two click... BAM, now yer hospital bill is larger than the national debt of County Cork!

Here's a wee secret from the gutter: Anonymous bounties ain't truly anonymous if you brag about it on the faction Discord after four shots of Jameson. Keep yer trap shut or ye'll find a mercenary sleepin' under yer doormat!

Did ye know a horse head in the mail actually lowers someone's happiness by 50%? If someone mailed a bloody equine noggin to me cottage in Galway, happiness is the last feckin' thing I'd be worryin' about!
Listen 'ere, ya thirsty rogue: drinkin' a Can of Red Cow gives you 10 energy, but a bottle of Mistletoe Madness gives you enough alcohol buzz to power a small trawler through the Irish Sea!

Holy saints above: you can hire a private detective to track someone's flight to Dubai, only to land right behind 'em and smack 'em with a trout. Truly, high-stakes international espionage at its finest!
The company directors who pay 500k a day to keep employees caffeinated with cans of Munster are the real saints of this city. Saint Peter will open the pearly gates and hand 'em a cold pint of lager!

Fact of the day, ya feckin' reprobate: if ye carry fifty million in cash through the streets instead of stickin' it in the faction vault, you're not brave—you're just free dinner for the first mugger with a rusty shiv!
By the pipes of Finnegan: did ye know throwing a brick at a faction leader's head in a ranked war does less damage than a single dirty bomb? But by Jaysus, it's ten times more insulting!
Pull up yer socks, boyo: flying abroad for seven hours to buy five camel plushies in the desert while dodging muggers at the terminal is what Torn economists call 'peak fiscal responsibility'!

I swear on me granny's rosary: training defense without dexterity is like putting titanium armor on a barn door—ye can take a cannonball to the face, but an eight-year-old child can kick ye in the shins and walk away laughing!

Did ye know reading a book in Torn takes an entire month? Thirty bloody days to finish one paperback! Either our characters have the reading comprehension of a boiled turnip, or that font is smaller than a flea's eyeball!
Listen 'ere ya rascal: if ye ever find a parachute in the city dump, don't ask who jumped without it. Just grab it, flog it on the market, and pretend ye never saw the crater in the sidewalk!
Listen 'ere... *hic*... I'm tellin' ya, that lad Tornhole absolutely bloody loves that tune 'Big Rock Candy Mountain', so he does! Feckin' brilliant song, I swear to god.
